planned_trials.intent: Reduce unnecessary density without making cell count the primary target.
planned_trials.name: trial-01-coarser-global-size
operator_changes: Increase the global element size or relevance center by about 10 to 15 percent.
Do not touch named selections, body suppression, or topology cleanup settings.
Keep all method assignments identical to the baseline mesh branch.

planned_trials.intent: Recover quality near the inlet and spiral while still allowing a coarser global field.
planned_trials.name: trial-02-local-inlet-spiral-refine
operator_changes: Apply inlet-region local sizing consistently to both `liquid-inlet` and `steam-inlet` unless deliberately testing something else later.
Add only local face or body sizing near the inlet split edge and spiral region at about 10 to 15 percent finer than the surrounding field.
Do not create new scoping selections; reuse only existing selectable entities.

planned_trials.intent: Reduce abrupt size jumps without materially changing the geometry definition.
planned_trials.name: trial-03-adjust-growth-rate
operator_changes: Make the growth rate slightly smoother, for example one conservative notch lower than the baseline.
Leave proximity and curvature capture logic unchanged unless they were already active in the baseline branch.

planned_trials.intent: Improve transition quality around refined zones while staying conservative on total-cell growth.
planned_trials.name: trial-04-smoother-transition
operator_changes: Prefer slower or smoother transition behavior if that control is available in the active meshing method.
Do not switch mesh method families unless the baseline branch already uses multiple compatible methods.

planned_trials.intent: Try a mild wall treatment only after earlier trials reopen cleanly.
planned_trials.name: trial-05-mild-inflation-if-stable
operator_changes: Apply only if Trials 01 to 04 generate and export successfully.
Use a mild inflation setup such as a small number of layers and gentle growth.
Abort this trial if inflation introduces collapses, negative volume warnings, or worse reopen behavior.
